name: Qentrah brand bundle

clearSpace.preferredUse: Keep the mark centered with generous white space around all edges.
doNot: Do not stretch, skew, or rotate the mark.
Do not add shadows, gradients, textures, or decorative effects.
Do not place the mark over a busy image.
Do not add extra symbols inside the icon canvas.

uiUxRules.brandPresence: Use the Qentrah mark as a calm primary identifier, not as decoration.
layout: Keep the main screen restrained, spacious, and focused on the primary action.
Use clear hierarchy: brand mark, screen title, primary action, then secondary actions.
Avoid nested cards and decorative visual noise around the logo.
color: Use white or near-white surfaces for brand-sign-in and launch screens.
Use #121212 for the primary mark on white.
Use #011B5A only where the existing dark-blue logo variant is explicitly needed.
accessibility: Maintain strong contrast between the logo and its background.
Do not rely on the logo alone to communicate an action.

openAiBrandReferenceNotes: Use prescribed clear space and let the mark breathe.
Do not stretch or alter marks.
Do not add unauthorized colors, effects, textures, or elements.
Do not imply endorsement or partnership unless explicitly approved.
